name: AppImage for Omarchy
author: glasschan
description: Every AppImage, one panel: integrate downloads with a click (desktop entry + icon extracted), launch, update in place, or remove — with per-app GitHub release sources (pre-filled editors), background update checks that notify you, a pinnable compact window and a live bar badge. Python stdlib only, no daemon — derived from GearLever (GPL-3.0).

barWidget.description: Integrate, list, launch, update, and remove AppImages.
